slot_scores.name: unclear_production_time_goal
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the 110-hour weekly production time limit a hard ceiling that cannot be exceeded, or is it the regular-time capacity where any production beyond it counts as overtime hours to be minimized?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent probed the hardness of the 110-hour limit (hard ceiling vs. capacity threshold), touching the hard-vs-soft dimension, but it never asked whether fully utilizing 110 hours is a goal, nor about its priority relative to the other objectives, so the goal-programming meaning of H1 was not covered.

slot_scores.name: unclear_overtime_limit_goal
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the 10-hour maximum overtime limit a hard ceiling that must not be exceeded, or is it a soft target that can be violated with a penalty?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent directly asked whether the 10-hour overtime rule is a rigid constraint or a soft/penalized target, matching the strict-constraint-vs-soft-target aspect of the semantic hit rule (priority aspect not asked but the rule is disjunctive).

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: That the 110-hour figure functions purely as a regular-time capacity / overtime threshold with no requirement or goal to fully utilize the 110 hours.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked whether full utilization of the 110 hours is an objective (or its priority); it only asked whether 110 could be exceeded, then committed in READY_TO_MODEL to a formulation listing 110 as 'Regular-Time Capacity' with 'No Other Constraints' and 'Assumptions: None,' silently dropping any full-utilization goal.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P0 slot H1 (whether fully utilizing 110 hours is a prioritized goal) remained only partially addressed and never confirmed, so a P0 hidden slot was still unresolved at stop.

summary: The agent resolved the overtime-limit goal question (H2) well and clarified rates, bounds, and the objective, but it only partially probed the 110-hour production-time slot (H1), never asking whether full utilization is a prioritized goal, and then stopped with an unconfirmed P0 assumption baked into its model.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
